rebrew.schema.json is a verbatim copy of contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
from the relumea backend (ai.relumea.app.backend-go), copied at commit
dcca3f9e176f157f5114237e72cf47b370581e72. The file last changed there in
e812d79fabb4ba0c66d52ec78a97cb00c514ca84. The backend generates it with
`go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`; replace this copy when the contract changes,
never edit it here. tests/test_ops.py validates every op request and reply
against it.
